articles.title: ‘Kremlin Killed Lindsey...’: Putin Govt Insider EXPOSES Graham Death Plot; ‘POISONED IN UKRAINE...’
articles.description: Did the Kremlin have a motive to target Senator Lindsey Graham? Russian sociologist Igor Eidman has sparked controversy after speculating—without presenting evidence—that Russian intelligence may have been behind the Republican senator's sudden death. Eidman cited Graham's outspoken support for Ukraine, his push for tougher sanctions on Russia, and his recent visit to Kyiv as reasons why Moscow could have viewed him as a threat. He also floated an unverified poisoning theory linked to Graham's Ukraine trip. No U.S. authority has suggested foul play, and there is no evidence connecting Russia to Graham's death. Graham's office said the senator died following a "brief and sudden illness."
